Approved patch campaign
Pinned vendor image and target list

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compatibility checks
Hardware / firmware / drivers / release matrix

span.p:
Signed maintenance authorization
Exact image + host + change window

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Acquire host and cluster lease
Fence conflicting workflow writers

div.style: color: rgb(208, 224, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Read live preconditions
Cluster healthy / free capacity / backups
No conflicting storage resync

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Admission and
safety checks pass?

div.style: color: rgb(239, 194, 199) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hold campaign and alert owner
No automatic capacity guess

div.style: color: rgb(208, 224, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evacuate or shut down approved guests
Respect affinity and migration compatibility

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host drained and
remaining services healthy?

div.style: color: rgb(208, 224, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Enter maintenance mode
Confirm via VMware task status

div.style: color: rgb(208, 224, 245) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Apply tested patch image
Reboot if required

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verify host rejoin
Networking / storage / time / agents

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host and service
checks pass?

div.style: color: rgb(208, 224, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exit maintenance; gradual workload return
Observe health before next target

div.style: color: rgb(219, 209, 241) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Commit evidence and new baseline
Release lease

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
More approved hosts
within same window?

div.style: color: rgb(219, 209, 241) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Campaign complete
Report verified results

div.style: color: rgb(239, 194, 199) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keep failed host isolated
Execute approved recovery procedure
or escalate for reinstall / vendor support

div.style: color: rgb(209, 218, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human on-call and hardware technician
Independent console or BMC access

div.style: color: rgb(219, 209, 241) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Campaign paused
Persist evidence; release safe leases
